scripts.db:sync-only: npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register -e "(async () => { const sequelize = (await import('./src/config/database')).default; await import('./src/models/index'); await sequelize.authenticate(); await sequelize.sync({ force: true }); console.log('All models were synchronized successfully (force: true).'); })().catch((e) => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); });"
scripts.db:sync: npm run db:sync-only && npm run seed
scripts.seed:full-reset: npm run db:sync-only && npm run seed && npm run seed:academic-structure && npm run seed:subject-groups && ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/seeders/bulkMatriculationsSeeder.ts --count=300 && npm run seed:unregistered
scripts.db:sync:sqlite: cross-env ENV_FILE=.env.sqlite npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/syncSqlite.ts
scripts.seed:sqlite: cross-env ENV_FILE=.env.sqlite npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/seed.ts
scripts.setup:sqlite: npm run db:sync:sqlite && npm run seed:sqlite && cross-env ENV_FILE=.env.sqlite npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/seeders/academicStructureSeeder.ts && cross-env ENV_FILE=.env.sqlite npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/seeders/subjectGroupsSeeder.ts
